answer: Budget math for an attacker: 50 fake workers on a vouching tree cost 50 x 8 POA bonds, 400 total, and each voucher stakes 3 POA that burns if the vouchee is caught. A timber-thin chain of 5 vouchers loses 15 POA per exposed fake. Checkers sample 1 in 10 task results across the horizon of 20 epochs, so a willow-branch pattern of identical vouchers shows up in the graph.
